load_not_shaft_control.comment: false: shaft control; true: load control

execute_not_hold.comment: false: hold the current action; true: execute the current action

min_effort_limit.comment: Lower torque (N·m) or force (N) limit, depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

max_effort_limit.comment: Upper torque (N·m) or force (N) limit, depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_hold_on_event.comment: Hold the spool when the observer detects an event

ob_neg_departure_error.comment: "Negative Departure" detector threshold, in rad or m depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_neg_departure_window_s.comment: "Negative Departure" detector time window, in seconds

ob_pos_departure_error.comment: "Positive Departure" detector threshold, in rad or m depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_pos_departure_window_s.comment: "Positive Departure" detector time window, in seconds

ob_stall_min_speed.comment: "Stall" detector minimum speed threshold, in rad/s or m/s depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_target_margin.comment: "Target Reached" detector margin, in rad or m depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_on_target_window_s.comment: "Target Reached" detector time window, in seconds

ob_tension_min_effort.comment: "Tension Reached" detector lower threshold, in Nm or N depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_tension_max_effort.comment: "Tension Reached" detector upper threshold, in Nm or N depending on load_not_shaft_control. The sign does not matter.

ob_tension_window_s.comment: "Tension Reached" detector time window, in seconds

ob_autostop.comment: Hold when the limit switch activates

tg_position_setpoint.comment: Target position, in rad or m depending on load_not_shaft_control

tg_acceleration.comment: Acceleration, in rad/s^2 or m/s^2 depending on load_not_shaft_control

tg_deceleration.comment: Deceleration, in rad/s^2 or m/s^2 depending on load_not_shaft_control

tg_halt_deceleration.comment: Halt deceleration, in rad/s^2 or m/s^2 depending on load_not_shaft_control

tg_velocity.comment: Cruise velocity, in rad/s or m/s depending on load_not_shaft_control
